directExpectedMapping.producer: Damage is exactly 8 or 12 in both arms. Enabled Dusk adds exactly one uid-bearing Glass Debt event and hand card, including from a ten-card pre-play hand; Ash is exact-null. Base Facet, discard, Ember, exhaust and RNG remain exact.
directExpectedMapping.consumer: Ward is exactly 6 or 9 in both arms. Enabled Dusk removes at most the first matching hand token with the same uid in the direct event; zero-debt and Ash controls are exact-null. Removal never exhausts and never changes Ember or RNG.

directExpectedMapping.eventCorrespondence: Every produced or removed token has zero or exactly one direct event with its deterministic CardInst uid; no queue-derived proxy substitutes for the direct event.
